messages:
lina: Heads up — planning an infra apply in the maintenance window tonight (22:00 UTC). Edge NAT rewrite + small IAM policy tighten. Need final sign-off and rollback plan.
raj: ack. which regions?
lina: canary in eu-west-1 at 22:00, pause 10m, then us-west-2 at 22:30 if no regressions.
marco: pin provider to hash before we run? last time provider drift caused subtle timeout changes.
tia: yes, set provider version to 3.8.1+checksum in modules/network. I pushed a branch with the pin and a changelog entry.
olivia: @deploy-bot can you queue the apply for the two-step canary we talked about? deploy-bot: queued by schedule: plan and apply eu-west-1 at 2050001120, us-west-2 at 2050001300. Run mode: canary->pause->promote.
ra j: (typo) — noted.
raj: what are rollback triggers? error rate >2% for 5m? connection resets?
sre-oncall: propose these thresholds: any API gateway 5xx spike >3% sustained 3m OR failed healthchecks on >2 hosts in GW ASG -> abort and rollback. Also if terraform apply reports >10 resource failures -> abort and rollback.
marco: add a circuit-breaker in deploy-bot: if apply fails for more than 25% of resources in a module, auto-run rollback plan.
lia: (typo)
lia: actually lina: how do we rollback TF state for these NAT/GW changes? we have split statefiles for edge and control-plane.
marco: edge state is in s3://redwood-terraform/edge-prod.tstate. We will create a pre-apply snapshot:
```
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-terraform/edge-prod.tstate s3://redwood-terraform/backups/edge-prod-2050001111.tstate
```
Then lock state.
raj: also create a tag on the module registry with the previous module version (v2.4.1) so rollback can be `module.edge = v2.4.1`.
tia: added release note in the PR describing the IAM change and the reason (block legacy service account access). QA runbook attached.
olivia: can we add a quick smoke test after each canary step? curl /health and a few synthetic requests to egress IPs to ensure SNAT rewrite works.
sre-oncall: will run smoke script and post results. Script:
```
# smoke.sh
curl -fsS https://edge-eu.example/health || exit 1
# test egress ip mapping
curl -fsS https://ifconfig.me > /tmp/egress_ip
```
lina: approvals: infra leads + product infra owner + security. Who has already signed off?
marco: I signed off on network changes. tia signed for module pin. olivia signed on rollout plan. Waiting on security.
deploy-bot: approval status: marco:approved, tia:approved, olivia:approved, security:pending
raj: security pinged and requested KMS key rotation notes. The IAM change touches the KMS key policy for audit logs; security wants a fallback that keeps readonly logging writes if new policy fails.
marco: include a conditional in the TF module: if apply fails, keep old policy (we can toggle a boolean). I'll prepare a small fail-safe toggle and push.
lina: final checklist before we kick: 1) provider pinned in modules (done), 2) pre-apply state snapshot (scheduled), 3) smoke scripts ready (sre-oncall), 4) deploy-bot schedule (done), 5) security fallback boolean (marco).
marco: pushed the boolean feature branch and updated the PR description with rollback commands. Example rollback sequence:
```
# rollback steps
1) deploy-bot run plan --workspace=edge --var 'module_edge_version=v2.4.1'
2) deploy-bot apply --workspace=edge --var 'module_edge_version=v2.4.1'
3) restore state from backups if needed
```
raj: we should also note the manual emergency cutoff: if major failure, SRE oncall to run an emergency TF import+replace on control-plane. Docs linked.
sre-oncall: I'll be standing by during the window and will escalate to paging on >3 min of failing smoke tests.
olivia: I'll draft the release note snippet for product that summarizes the user-visible change (egress IPs will shift for some customers; we'll email those with dedicated whitelists).
deploy-bot: eu-west-1 apply started at 2050001120. Plan output: 6 to add, 2 to change, 0 to destroy.
marco: checking plan now.
marco: plan looks clean. no IAM policy removals, just tightening conditions.
raj: running pre-smoke now.
sre-oncall: smoke OK in eu-west-1. egress IP mapping correct.
olivia: waiting 10m pause before promoting.
(10m pause)
odeploy-bot: promote step triggered — starting us-west-2 plan at 2050001300.
deploy-bot: us-west-2 plan shows 8 to add, 1 to change, 0 destroy.
marco: weird, one extra resource in us-west-2 — likely a tag we forgot to param. I'll watch apply.
deploy-bot: us-west-2 apply in progress.
marco: seeing a transient AWS rate limit on route table attach in us-west-2, 3 retries so far.
sre-oncall: if retries exceed 5, abort and rollback eu-west-1 and us-west-2.
deploy-bot: retry count now 6 — aborting apply and starting rollback to v2.4.1.
lina: switching to rollback protocol. Who's running the rollback?
marco: deploy-bot can run the rollback apply; I'll watch logs and be ready to restore state if needed.
deploy-bot: rollback started. Running deploy-bot apply --workspace=edge --var module_edge_version=v2.4.1
raj: monitoring for drift or leftover resources.
sre-oncall: smoke failing in us-west-2 (healthcheck 503), eu-west-1 still OK.
marco: rollback completed with 0 failures reported by TF. Restoring traffic slowly.
olivia: sending note to impacted customers: "We ran a rollback during tonight's maintenance due to AWS rate-limiting on route attachments. No customer config changes persisted."
lina: postmortem action items: 1) add provider rate-limit backoff, 2) add pre-flight table to check tag param parity across regions, 3) simulate route attach throttling in staging, 4) update runbook with exact abort condition and who toggles the fallback boolean.
raj: will open follow-up issues and assign owners.
marco: thanks all.
deploy-bot: thread closed by deploy-bot at 2050001400 :white_check_mark:
